title: Contextual Need Prioritization Model
description: Resolves editorial priority dynamically based on narrative beat context. Rejects universal or rigid precedence hierarchies.
core_principles: Need prioritization is strictly CONTEXTUAL to the active narrative moment.
No universal precedence hierarchy exists across all beats (e.g., comprehension does not blindly override visual proof without context).
Needs compete qualitatively based on viewer cognitive state, verbal proposition, and visual debt.

candidate_need_categories.description: Interventions required when spoken content presents high cognitive complexity, fast numbers, or confusing phrasing.
candidate_need_categories.typical_context: Dense financial figures, legal terms, or rapid multi-part statements.

candidate_need_categories.description: Interventions where explicit visual evidence is called for by verbal claims.
candidate_need_categories.typical_context: Mentions of specific amenities, views, materials, locations, or spaces.

candidate_need_categories.description: Maintaining clear orientation of who is speaking, what property is being shown, and where it is situated.
candidate_need_categories.typical_context: Transitions between macro-location, building amenities, and private unit interiors.

candidate_need_categories.description: Managing rhythm, pauses, and momentum across the narrative arc.
candidate_need_categories.typical_context: Breathing pauses after key revelations or momentum shifts before calls to action.

candidate_need_categories.description: Fostering trust, rapport, and emotional resonance with the presenter and property lifestyle.
candidate_need_categories.typical_context: Opening hook questions, personal consultative advice, and direct closing invitations.

conflict_resolution_heuristic.approach: Contextual qualitative evaluation of viewer attention, narrative debt, and disruption cost.
